description: FORS1 was the first FOcal Reducer and low-dispersion Spectrograph on the VLT. These bands are the original Bessell and Gunn broad-band set, as ESO optical-bench transmission scans.
facility_description: The ESO Very Large Telescope stands at the Paranal Observatory in Chile.

links.label: FORS1 and FORS2 user manual, period 82

notes: ESO's filter page still serves the M_BESS and M_GUNN lab scans and says the later u/b/v/g_HIGH filters were bought in 2007 for the FORS1 blue-sensitive mosaic; NJM keeps those HIGH scans, plus R_SPECIAL and the I_BESS+77 collimator scan, under Paranal/FORS2. The page says B/V/I_BESS existed on both FORS1 and FORS2 and does not say which unit was scanned. Curves are filter-only. Appenzeller et al. 1998, The Messenger 94, 1 (1998Msngr..94....1A) is the commissioning article; check_refs did not resolve that bibcode, so it is not listed. No magnitude system is stated on the filter page.

B_BESS.Comments: ESO optical-bench scan M_BESS_B.txt. The FORS filter page labels it BESS_B. The scan is not Bessell's 1990 tabulated passband.

I_BESS.Comments: ESO optical-bench scan M_BESS_I.txt. The same page also links a separate I_BESS+77 collimator scan, which NJM files under Paranal/FORS2.

g_GUNN.Comments: ESO optical-bench scan M_GUNN_G.txt. The page labels the set GUNN.
